answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: The median first divergence of 8 and edit distance of 0.562 fit fine-tuned, not quantized (10-17) or system-prompted (0 and 0.79-0.82). The layer-1 L2 of 0.084 is just below the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092) and far from the system-prompted range (0.113-0.133). L2 grows to 0.429 at layer 32, with a final-layer jump of +0.116, cosine 0.900, effective rank 3.15, direction consistency 0.708 and a size ratio of 1.022. All of these match fine-tuned, and the size ratio above 1 rules out quantized and system-prompted. The layer-2 spike of 4.6 is small, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64). KL 0.080 and top-1 agreement 0.926 are consistent with fine-tuned. The raw-score shift ratio of 11.3 is slightly above the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8) but is still much closer to it than to the others.
